operations_performed: Read xcodebuild -version and simulator SDK version.
Read simctl list devices available, already booted simulator installed app metadata, and installed Unit application-bundle Info.plist only.
Read existing Unit source, native workspace/Pods/SDK metadata and tool availability.
operations_not_performed: No simulator boot/shutdown, application launch/switch, build/install, native UI input, permission grant, login, private data-container read, server start/stop, browser, DB or original source change.

host.read_only_simctl: Sandbox could not connect to CoreSimulatorService; the explicitly authorized read-only elevated metadata check succeeded.
host.physical_device_state: Not examined; no physical device or hardware capability is claimed.

installed_unit_bundle_metadata.limits: Installed version/native metadata is not proof of current source/patch/native-module correspondence. Current foreground app, session, credentials, selected unit, runtime behavior and service connection were not inspected.

limits: Existing workspace and matching installed Pods are prerequisites, not evidence that a fresh native build succeeds.
Native Mapbox, secure storage, LiveKit/WebRTC, CallKeep and custom plugins require the proper development client; ordinary Expo Go is not a substitute.
Do not run prebuild or pod install in the original Unit repo merely to probe readiness. Use a separately reviewed managed recording copy if the installed native client is incompatible.

local_service_and_session_requirements: Use only the dedicated local training API/gateway; env.js otherwise defaults to a QA service. Never start with its default remote origin.

The client resolves a normally saved base URL before the environment fallback. Because no native private storage was inspected, current native service selection is unknown; confirm through supported visible settings/login before any sign-in.
Respect current native shared-device/member/MFA guards. Never inject or copy browser storage/tokens, disable checks, or alter account settings.
Keep Mapbox execution values inherited only; do not print, save or capture them. Preserve analytics-off local settings from the existing recording recipe.
Use a separate Metro port if needed, with explicit --clear under CI; do not stop the existing web19103 listener implicitly.
Preserve the existing booted simulator/app sessions. A different simulator or app launch is a later intentional operation, not part of this assessment.

prospective_capture_path_not_executed.action: Parent reviews installed native/source compatibility and chooses whether the existing development client can consume the exact managed recording source. Preserve existing sessions.
If needed, explicitly start a dedicated local development Metro using installed CLI and local-only environment; no install/build/clone occurs implicitly.
environment_names_only: local analytics-off variables from existing recorder recipe

prospective_capture_path_not_executed.action: Open the approved local Metro project through the installed development client using its normal UI/deep link, then visibly verify service and perform normal fictional sign-in only if needed. No execution yet.

Select only an authorized inventory-bearing unit through Active Unit, inspect actual stock/recent count, save/reopen a training Draft, then show actual native Complete/Cancel confirmation and the chosen bounded outcome.

Capture each full native screen with screenshot hash/dimensions/time, bundle/platform/runtime and genuine action/readback provenance. Use human UI interaction or a separately authorized native UI driver; simctl alone is not an ordinary tap driver.
Retain native captures as native source evidence until a reviewed native provenance validation contract exists; keep existing browser capture provenance intact.

functions_native_can_potentially_show: React Native Alert.alert reaches iOS Alert.prompt/native alert manager; genuine confirmation controls for count Complete/Cancel and route End Route may be recordable once the normal app is actually exercised.
iOS photo-library permission/picker controls and resulting selected public software fixture may be inspectable. These are distinct from physical camera acquisition.
limits_and_remaining_gaps: No native confirmation, count mutation, camera/library operation or native provider result was actually exercised in this assessment.
Simulator screens cannot establish real physical camera/GPS arrival/Bluetooth/PTT/push delivery. Never accept actual user GPS or claim native hardware testing from simulator UI.

Camera permission/source availability is still an actual runtime boundary. Current expo-image-picker code requests/uses native camera; do not assume successful acquisition from simulator availability.
Maestro/Appium/idb/applesimutils and a Unit native UI-test harness are absent. Human interaction or separately approved driver setup is required for automated ordinary native taps.

Current strict verify_capture_evidence.py requires browser_screenshot and URL for application screenshots; native screenshots need a separate reviewed contract with actual simulator/bundle/route/source identity. Do not relabel them browser screenshots or invent DOM/URL metadata.

Any future native provenance extension must keep raw assets/hash identity, full visible controls, source binding, exact speech/timing/frame and genuine playback gates; no validator change is made here.
qualification: Read-only feasibility assessment only; no app, source candidate, native scene, video, site or publication is qualified.
